cleavage_agent: Proteolytic peptides were generated following the FASP protocol of Wiśniewski et al., with minor modifications as described by Hamann et al..

instrument.evidence: All samples were analyzed by one-dimensional LC-MS/MS as described by Hinzke et al., using 4-h gradients.

labeling: inferred: No isobaric labels were used in this study.
mass_analyzer: The Sequest HT node in Proteome Discoverer version 2.0.0.802 (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
reduction_reagent: Tissues were disrupted by bead beating for 45 s at 6.0 m/s with lysing matrix D tubes (MP Biomedicals) in SDT buffer (4% [wt/vol] sodium dodecyl sulfate [SDS], 100 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.6, 0.1 M dithiothreitol [DTT])
